method: Ranked by claude-sonnet-5-5, which read 13 of 14 shortlisted pieces

picks.title: Love, Logical Gates, and Unrealistic Expectations
picks.author: Shayan Majidy
picks.why_it_matters: Quantum error-correcting codes with cheap automorphism gates: proves exact qubit-count bounds (exponential for CNOTs, quadratic for S/CZ), framed through a matchmaker metaphor.

picks.title: TLAPS-Bench: Formally Proving Correctness Of Real-World System Specifications With TLA+ Proof System
picks.author: Murat (noreply@blogger.com)
picks.why_it_matters: Pairing a model checker with a prover to falsify candidate inductive invariants shows how agents can prove distributed protocols correct, not just model-check them.

picks.title: The Part About the Machines
picks.author: Brunella Tipismana Urbano
picks.why_it_matters: A Peruvian writer-reporter argues about AI-text detection and a disputed prize novel, separating false positives from false negatives with real evidence.

picks.title: AI Accelerators Drive Changes In Power Delivery Networks
picks.author: Laura Peters
picks.why_it_matters: Kiloamp currents at 0.7 V make resistive loss and droop a chip-level limiter, pushing voltage regulators into the package and interposer.

picks.title: The End Of Extraction
picks.author: Benjamin Siegel
picks.why_it_matters: A historian traces how lab substitutes (madder dye, nylon, now bioreactor omega-3s and nicotine) strand extractive economies, and why biotech speeds it up.
